title: [human] Spec 05-routing 9.8: assign the IPv6 option type for the DTN S-flag HBH option
description: While implementing b7z9.8.2.1 (HBH TLV walk): the DTN absolute-expiry option is pinned by spec as Type=0x03 (implemented in C router.c parse_ipv6_dispatch), but the DTN Flags option (S|Reserved, 1 byte, 'in IPv6 hop-by-hop options') has NO option type assigned anywhere in spec/docs (broadcast HBH is literally TBD1 in docs/spec-chapter-breakdowns.md). Cross-implementation parity (b7z9.8.3) and the S-flag parse need this value. Decision needed from Mark: pick the option type value (and whether Reserved bits must be zero on send/accept), or redefine S-flag carriage (e.g. folded into the 0x03 expiry option). Interim C behavior: expiry option parsed; S-flag not parsed; the router decision bead (b7z9.8.2.2) will treat presence of the 0x03 expiry as the store-and-forward indication until the flags option is defined.
